reference: As kids they would buy dried herbs in a jar.
sk: Ako deti kupovali sušené bylinky v pohári.
cz: Jako děti kupovali sušené bylinky ve skleničce.
acceptable: As {kids|children} they {would|used to} buy dried herbs in a jar.
When they were {kids|children} they {would|used to} buy dried herbs in a jar.
They {would|used to} buy dried herbs in a jar {as|when they were} {kids|children}.

mistakes.text: As {kids|children} they bought dried herbs in a jar.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Opakovaný zvyk v minulosti tu vyjadri cez „would buy“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Opakovaný zvyk v minulosti tu vyjádři pomocí „would buy“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Show a repeated past habit with “would buy”.

mistakes.text: As {kids|children} they would {bought|buying} dried herbs in a jar.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „would“ patrí holý tvar slovesa: „would buy“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „would“ následuje holý tvar slovesa: „would buy“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “would” use the bare verb: “would buy”.

mistakes.text: As {kids|children} they were buying dried herbs in a jar.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Past Continuous neopisuje opakovaný zvyk; treba „would buy“ alebo „used to buy“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Past Continuous nepopisuje opakovaný zvyk; je potřeba „would buy“ nebo „used to buy“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The Past Continuous doesn't describe a repeated habit; use “would buy” or “used to buy”.

mistakes.text: Like kids they would buy dried herbs in a jar.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Ako deti“ (v detstve) je „as kids“; „like kids“ znamená „podobne ako deti“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Jako děti“ (v dětství) je „as kids“; „like kids“ znamená „podobně jako děti“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “As kids” means “when they were kids”; “like kids” means “in the way kids do”.

mistakes.text: As {kids|children} they used to buying dried herbs in a jar.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „used to“ patrí Infinitive bez „-ing“: „used to buy“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „used to“ následuje Infinitive bez „-ing“: „used to buy“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “used to” use the Infinitive, not “-ing”: “used to buy”.
